author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
Skin plastered against tattered holes
of a torn blanket.
Rough threads of
unwoven time
scratching against frozen thighs
She sighs, glancing beyond
a shoulder tucked close to
heart
beyond the cold
frosted window she see nothing
nothing at all
